title: The co-area formula is countably additive over a Borel partition modulo a null set with null slices (Simon Ch. 3, 2.8–2.9)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel, f : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P any map, and A_j ⊆ M (j ∈ ℕ) pairwise disjoint Borel sets. Write M₀ := M ∖ ⋃_j A_j and Hᵏ = μHE[k]. Assume H^{n+1}(M₀) = 0; Hⁿ(M₀ ∩ f⁻¹(t)) = 0 for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ; and for every j and every Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], t ↦ ∫_{A_j∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ is L¹-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{A_j∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ dt = ∫_{A_j} |G| g dH^{n+1}. Then for every Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], t ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ is L¹-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ dt = ∫_M |G| g dH^{n+1}. (All integrals are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞]; |G| enters as ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖; dt is Lebesgue measure on ℝ.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → Measurable f → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) → (∀ j, A j ⊆ M) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → μHE[n + 1] (M \ ⋃ j, A j) = 0 → (∀ᵐ t, μHE[n] ((M \ ⋃ j, A j) ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0) → (∀ j, ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in A j, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]
